subject: Proposal: consolidate MDM/EDR vendors & procurement timeline
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:04:00 -0000
Subject: Proposal: consolidate MDM/EDR vendors & procurement timeline

Team —

We have three endpoint contracts coming up across the org (MDM + EDR + vuln scanning) with overlapping renewal windows in Oct–Nov. I did a quick intake with IT security and finance; the ask: evaluate if we can consolidate onto a single vendor (or two vendors) to reduce administrative overhead and lock in 24/7 SOC support.

Attached: SecureWave's initial quote and my cost model that aggregates current spend. High level proposal: pilot SecureWave for corporate macOS and Windows fleets (EDR + unified MDM integration) and keep Cyberscan for vuln scanning for now; if pilot meets detection/false-positive targets we consolidate fully in Q1.

Questions I'd like answered this week so we can start procurement lane:
- Procurement: can we compress approval to a 3-week PO cycle (we'd need signed SOW + PO by 10/05)?
- Security: what are the evidence gaps for SecureWave's SOC2 and vuln management attestation? Mina, can you flag any showstoppers?
- Cost: Rishi, please validate the consolidation model assumptions in the attached spreadsheet.

I'll loop in SecureWave for updated final pricing. Thanks — if everyone is OK, I'll schedule a quick sync with the vendor Thurs 16th.

Marcus Lin
Head of Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): SecureWave_quote_Sept2026.pdf; Consolidation_cost_model.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:12:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Proposal: consolidate MDM/EDR vendors & procurement timeline

Thanks Marcus —

Quick notes:
- Developer productivity team prefers we avoid any agent changes during the Nov feature freeze window; pilot should target a <5% install churn and weekend rollouts only.
- Can we scope the pilot to 1,500 endpoints (corporate only) rather than full fleet? That will make procurement cleaner.
- Also curious about licensing: SecureWave's quote bundles per-endpoint EDR + MDM at a per-seat rate. Is there a separate fee for integration with our UEM?

Mina/Rishi — can you both validate the pilot scope & costs? If IT approves, I support the Thurs sync.

—Marissa
Senior IT Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): none
From: Joe Sullivan <joe.sullivan@securewave.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@securewave.com
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 14:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Proposal: consolidate MDM/EDR vendors & procurement timeline

Hi Marcus/Marissa —

Appreciate the summary. We can do a 1,500 endpoint pilot with weekend installer windows and an option to phase to full fleet in Q1. A few clarifications:

- Licensing: pilot price is per endpoint with MDM integration included at no extra per-seat cost for our supported UEMs (we'll confirm compatibility in the Thursday call).
- SOC2 / compliance: our security team uploaded our SOC2 Type II attestation and control mapping last week; contracts@securewave.com can provide additional artifact bundles on request.
- Pricing flexibility: we can offer a 12% consolidation discount if you commit to a 12-month enterprise subscription at pilot conversion.

I've attached an updated PDF quote that includes the discount and a draft SOW. If we can get an LOI by 09/22 we can lock pricing and an implementation kickoff date in early Oct.

Proposed meeting: Thu 16 Sep, 10:00 PT for a 30-min scoping call. I'm happy to adjust.

Best,
Joe Sullivan
Enterprise Accounts — SecureWave

Attachment(s): SecureWave_quote_Sept2026.pdf; Vendor_SOW_draft.docx
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Proposal: consolidate MDM/EDR vendors & procurement timeline

Marcus —

Quick compliance read after scanning SecureWave's artifacts:
- SOC2 Type II present; evidence window valid through Aug 2026 but we need a bridge letter for controls between Aug and Oct. Request from contracts@securewave.com.
- Data residency: SecureWave supports EU processing but the business requested logs to remain in our VPC for private deployments; their enterprise plan supports tokenized log forwarding — will need engineering sign-off but not a blocker.
- Vulnerability management: their vuln scanner integration currently lacks Jira automatic ticket creation; if we adopt, we should require this in the SOW.

Procurement note: finance needs the final SOW and a redline-friendly contract in docx; PDF-only quote won't work for PO processing.

Mina Haddad
Information Security Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): none
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Joe Sullivan <joe.sullivan@securewave.com>, contracts@securewave.com
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 15:22:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Proposal: consolidate MDM/EDR vendors & procurement timeline

Thanks everyone — good progress. Outcomes and next steps:

1) Pilot scope confirmed: 1,500 corporate endpoints, weekend rollout, target go-live by 2026-10-08.
2) SecureWave to send bridge letter for SOC2 controls and a redlineable docx SOW by end of day Friday 09/17. (Joe / contracts@securewave.com)
3) Rishi to validate the attached consolidation_cost_model.xlsx assumptions and update the finance sheet with the 12% discount if LOI signed by 09/22. (Rishi)
4) Mina to validate engineering sign-off for tokenized log forwarding by 09/21; require Jira ticket integration in SOW. (Mina)
5) I'll prepare a procurement packet (SOW, cost summary, PO template) for finance review — target submission 09/20.

Joe — please confirm you'll have the SOW and bridge letter by 09/17. If so I'll route to finance and legal immediately so we can meet the 10/05 internal PO deadline.

Marcus Lin
Head of Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): Consolidation_cost_model.xlsx
